# Coding Sharks

> Coding Sharks is a placement-focused coding bootcamp in Indore, India, offering live, project-based programs in Full Stack Web Development, AI Agents & Automation, Data Science, DSA, and System Design. 91%+ placement rate. Students build real production-grade projects and get 1-on-1 mentorship from senior engineers, plus direct referrals to 100+ hiring partners.

Coding Sharks trains career-switchers, fresh graduates (CS and non-CS), and working professionals. Programs are live cohorts (online + offline in Indore) with weekly project shipping and dedicated placement support. Most students receive a first offer within 4–8 weeks of completing a program. To enrol, book a free demo session.

## Courses
- [All Courses](https://www.thecodingsharks.com/courses): live, placement-focused coding programs
- [Full Stack Web Development](https://www.thecodingsharks.com/courses/full-stack): JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, databases, cloud
- [AI Agents & Automation](https://www.thecodingsharks.com/courses/ai-agents): Python, LangChain, LLM APIs, vector databases, agentic workflows
- [Data Science & Machine Learning](https://www.thecodingsharks.com/courses/data-science): Python, ML, data pipelines
- [DSA Mastery](https://www.thecodingsharks.com/courses/dsa-mastery): data structures & algorithms for interviews
- [System Design & DSA Masterclass](https://www.thecodingsharks.com/courses/system-design): scalable systems + interview prep
